name: /sdd:bug fix: an expansion beyond the assessed files is recorded, not silent

graders.why: the reproduction runs through app/cart.py, which the assessment did not list, so the fix cannot stay in scope. Expanding is correct; expanding without saying so leaves the assessment describing a change that no longer matches the diff
a deviation entry that names the file but not the evidence is a list, not a record. The next reader needs to know why the scope moved, not only that it did
a run that records a deviation it did not make is worse than one that made an unrecorded change. The reply has to show cart.py was actually touched
the spec repo is committed in the same turn; the source change stays uncommitted for the user, as everywhere else in this suite
graders.violating_example: git add app/cart.py && git commit -m 'fix discount'
